name: Jii Tousaku II ~Hametsu e no Kairaku~
original_name: 自慰倒錯II～破滅への快楽～
source:
Finally, Reiko's masturbation is seen by employees of the company. But Murakami saves her by proposing to her. However, Reiko is not satisfied with the boring family life. She accidentally meets her former acquaintance who drowns her again in the world of masturbation.
